name: Cache stampede (hot key expires)
description: Cache-aside: the API reads Redis first; on a miss it reads Postgres and writes the value back to Redis. TTL is 10 s. The hottest key gets about 1,000 reads per second, and a Postgres query takes 100 ms with only 16 connections. When the hot key expires, every read in the 100 ms the DB query takes is a miss, so over a hundred requests read the same row at once. The DB queues, the API fills up, and about 7% of requests fail. Compare with the "Cache lease + TTL jitter" example.
